author: Arnav
problem: Read N and a string S of N game results, 'T' if Takahashi won and 'A' if Aoki won. Print T or A for the overall winner: whoever won more games, or, if tied, whoever reached that number of wins first.
bug_description: On a tie it always prints A instead of checking who reached the tied count first (the one who didn't win the last game).

comments.accurate: Counts each player's wins and breaks a tie by who reached the final total first
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts each player's wins; Takahashi needs strictly more, otherwise Aoki takes it
comments.wrong_location: Tie-break verified; check the win count only matches the exact letter T

source.fixed_line: if cnt > N - cnt or (cnt == N - cnt and S[-1] == "A"):
